source_units.text: He said to me, “The injustice of the house of Israel and Judah has grown very, very great, because the land is full of many peoples, and the city full of injustice and uncleanness. For they said, ‘The Lord has abandoned the land; the Lord does not look upon it.’

source_units.text: My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy. I have brought their ways upon their heads.”
source_units.complete_text: My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy. I have brought their ways upon their heads.”

source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Your dead whom you struck within her are the meat, and she is the cauldron; but I will bring you out of her.

source_units.text: “Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and the whole house of Israel have been brought to an end. To them Jerusalem’s inhabitants said, ‘Keep far from the Lord; the land has been given to us as an inheritance.’

source_units.complete_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will thrust them away into the nations and scatter them through all the earth, and I will be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they may enter.’

source_units.complete_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women sewing cushions upon every elbow of an arm and making coverings upon every head of every age, to distort lives! The lives of My people were distorted, and they were preserving lives.

source_units.complete_text: They were profaning Me among My people for a handful of barley and scraps of bread, putting to death lives that ought not die and preserving lives that ought not live, as you uttered things to a people listening to vain pronouncements.

source_units.complete_text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against your cushions, on which you entangle lives. I will tear them from your arms and send the lives out—their lives that you twist away—into dispersion.

source_units.complete_text: I will tear your coverings and rescue My people from your hand. They will no longer be in your hands for entanglement, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.

source_units.complete_text: therefore you certainly will no longer see false things or divine divinations. I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”

source_units.text: “Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their faces. Shall I indeed answer them?
source_units.complete_text: “Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their faces. Shall I indeed answer them?

source_units.text: Therefore speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Anyone of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet—I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,
source_units.complete_text: Therefore speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Anyone of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet—I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,

source_units.complete_text: so that it may turn the house of Israel aside in accordance with their hearts, alienated from Me through their reflections.’

source_units.complete_text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Turn back and turn away from your practices and all your impieties, and turn your faces.

source_units.text: For anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners living among Israel who becomes alienated from Me, sets his reflections upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet to question him concerning Me—I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.
source_units.complete_text: For anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners living among Israel who becomes alienated from Me, sets his reflections upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet to question him concerning Me—I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.

source_units.complete_text: I will set My face firmly against that person, make him a wilderness and a devastation, and remove him from the midst of My people. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

source_units.text: If the prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray. I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.
source_units.complete_text: If the prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray. I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.

source_units.complete_text: so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from Me or be defiled by any of their transgressions. They will be My people, and I will be their God, says the Lord.’”

source_units.complete_text: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by committing a transgression, and I stretch My hand against it, shatter its support of bread, send famine upon it, and remove human and livestock from it,

source_units.complete_text: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were within it, they themselves would be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.

source_units.complete_text: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters would be saved; only they themselves would be saved, and the land would be destroyed.

source_units.complete_text: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, they certainly would not rescue sons or daughters; they alone would be saved.

source_units.complete_text: Or even if I send death upon that land and pour My wrath upon it in blood, to destroy human and livestock from it,

source_units.complete_text: and Noah, Daniel and Job were within it, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters would be left; they would rescue their own lives by their righteousness.

source_units.text: “And you, son of man, what could vinewood be among all the branch wood found among the forest trees?
source_units.complete_text: “And you, son of man, what could vinewood be among all the branch wood found among the forest trees?

source_units.text: Will they take wood from it to make anything useful? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel upon it?
source_units.complete_text: Will they take wood from it to make anything useful? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel upon it?

source_units.text: It has only been given to the fire to be consumed. Fire consumes its yearly prunings, and it is utterly spent. Surely it will not be useful for work?
source_units.complete_text: It has only been given to the fire to be consumed. Fire consumes its yearly prunings, and it is utterly spent. Surely it will not be useful for work?

source_units.text: Even when it is whole, it will not serve for work. How much less if fire consumes it completely—will it still serve for work?
source_units.complete_text: Even when it is whole, it will not serve for work. How much less if fire consumes it completely—will it still serve for work?

source_units.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: As with the vinewood among the forest trees, which I have given to the fire to be consumed, so I have given Jerusalem’s inhabitants.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: As with the vinewood among the forest trees, which I have given to the fire to be consumed, so I have given Jerusalem’s inhabitants.

source_units.text: I will set My face against them. They will come out of the fire, and fire will devour them. They will recognize that I am the Lord when I set My face firmly against them.
source_units.complete_text: I will set My face against them. They will come out of the fire, and fire will devour them. They will recognize that I am the Lord when I set My face firmly against them.

source_units.text: I will lay the land waste, because they have fallen into transgression, says the Lord.’”
source_units.complete_text: I will lay the land waste, because they have fallen into transgression, says the Lord.’”

source_units.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
source_units.complete_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

source_units.text: “Son of man, solemnly testify to Jerusalem about her lawlessness,
source_units.complete_text: “Son of man, solemnly testify to Jerusalem about her lawlessness,

source_units.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
source_units.complete_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

source_units.text: As for your birth, on the day you were born they did not bind your breasts; you were not washed with water, not salted with salt, and not wrapped in swaddling cloths.
source_units.complete_text: As for your birth, on the day you were born they did not bind your breasts; you were not washed with water, not salted with salt, and not wrapped in swaddling cloths.

source_units.text: Nor did My eye spare you to do any of all these things for you, to feel anything for you. You were cast upon the face of the plain because of your life’s crookedness, on the day you were born.
source_units.complete_text: Nor did My eye spare you to do any of all these things for you, to feel anything for you. You were cast upon the face of the plain because of your life’s crookedness, on the day you were born.

source_units.text: I passed by you and saw you befouled in your blood, and said to you, ‘From your blood, life!
source_units.complete_text: I passed by you and saw you befouled in your blood, and said to you, ‘From your blood, life!

source_units.text: Multiply!’ I have made you like the growth of the field. You multiplied, grew great and entered cities of cities. Your breasts stood firm and your hair grew, but you were naked and exposed.
source_units.complete_text: Multiply!’ I have made you like the growth of the field. You multiplied, grew great and entered cities of cities. Your breasts stood firm and your hair grew, but you were naked and exposed.

source_units.text: I passed through you and saw you; behold, your season was the season of those lodging. I spread My wings over you and covered your exposure. I swore to you and entered a covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became Mine.
source_units.complete_text: I passed through you and saw you; behold, your season was the season of those lodging. I spread My wings over you and covered your exposure. I swore to you and entered a covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became Mine.

source_units.text: I washed you with water, washed your blood off you, and anointed you with oil,
source_units.complete_text: I washed you with water, washed your blood off you, and anointed you with oil,

source_units.text: and clothed you in patterned garments, gave you blue-purple footwear, girded you with fine linen, and wrapped you in hair-woven cloth,
source_units.complete_text: and clothed you in patterned garments, gave you blue-purple footwear, girded you with fine linen, and wrapped you in hair-woven cloth,

source_units.text: and adorned you with ornaments, placed bracelets around your hands and a necklace around your neck,
source_units.complete_text: and adorned you with ornaments, placed bracelets around your hands and a necklace around your neck,

source_units.text: and put a ring around your nostril, little hoops upon your ears and a crown of boasting upon your head.
source_units.complete_text: and put a ring around your nostril, little hoops upon your ears and a crown of boasting upon your head.

source_units.text: You were adorned with gold and silver; your coverings were fine linen, hair-woven and patterned. You ate fine flour, oil and honey, and became very beautiful.
source_units.complete_text: You were adorned with gold and silver; your coverings were fine linen, hair-woven and patterned. You ate fine flour, oil and honey, and became very beautiful.

source_units.text: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was made complete in splendor, in the loveliness I placed upon you, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was made complete in splendor, in the loveliness I placed upon you, says the Lord.

source_units.text: You trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your fame. You poured out your prostitution upon every passerby—which will not be.
source_units.complete_text: You trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your fame. You poured out your prostitution upon every passerby—which will not be.

source_units.text: You took some of your garments, made sewn idols for yourself and prostituted yourself upon them. You certainly will not enter, nor will it come to be.
source_units.complete_text: You took some of your garments, made sewn idols for yourself and prostituted yourself upon them. You certainly will not enter, nor will it come to be.

source_units.text: You took your vessels of boasting from My gold and My silver, from what I had given you, made male images for yourself and prostituted yourself among them.
source_units.complete_text: You took your vessels of boasting from My gold and My silver, from what I had given you, made male images for yourself and prostituted yourself among them.

source_units.text: You took your patterned clothing and clothed them; you set My oil and My incense before them.
source_units.complete_text: You took your patterned clothing and clothed them; you set My oil and My incense before them.

source_units.text: My loaves that I gave you—fine flour, oil and honey with which I fed you—you set before them as a fragrant aroma. So it happened, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: My loaves that I gave you—fine flour, oil and honey with which I fed you—you set before them as a fragrant aroma. So it happened, says the Lord.

source_units.text: You took your sons and daughters whom you had borne and sacrificed them to them for consumption, as though you had prostituted yourself only a little,
source_units.complete_text: You took your sons and daughters whom you had borne and sacrificed them to them for consumption, as though you had prostituted yourself only a little,

source_units.text: and slaughtered your children and gave them over as you used them for averting rites.
source_units.complete_text: and slaughtered your children and gave them over as you used them for averting rites.

source_units.text: This was in addition to all your prostitution, and you did not remember the days of your infancy, when you were naked and exposed and lived befouled in your blood.
source_units.complete_text: This was in addition to all your prostitution, and you did not remember the days of your infancy, when you were naked and exposed and lived befouled in your blood.

source_units.text: After all your evils, says the Lord,
source_units.complete_text: After all your evils, says the Lord,

source_units.text: you built yourself a prostitution chamber and made yourself a display place in every broad street,
source_units.complete_text: you built yourself a prostitution chamber and made yourself a display place in every broad street,

source_units.text: and at the head of every road you built your brothels, ruined your beauty, spread your legs to every passerby, and multiplied your prostitution.
source_units.complete_text: and at the head of every road you built your brothels, ruined your beauty, spread your legs to every passerby, and multiplied your prostitution.

source_units.text: You prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors great in flesh, and prostituted yourself in many ways to anger Me.
source_units.complete_text: You prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors great in flesh, and prostituted yourself in many ways to anger Me.

source_units.text: But if I stretch My hand against you, I will remove your ordinances and hand you over to the desires of those who hate you, daughters of foreigners who turn you aside from your way in which you acted impiously.
source_units.complete_text: But if I stretch My hand against you, I will remove your ordinances and hand you over to the desires of those who hate you, daughters of foreigners who turn you aside from your way in which you acted impiously.

source_units.text: You prostituted yourself with the daughters of Assyria, and not even so were you filled; you prostituted yourself, and were not filled.
source_units.complete_text: You prostituted yourself with the daughters of Assyria, and not even so were you filled; you prostituted yourself, and were not filled.

source_units.text: You multiplied your covenants toward the Chaldeans’ land, and not even with these were you filled.
source_units.complete_text: You multiplied your covenants toward the Chaldeans’ land, and not even with these were you filled.

source_units.text: What shall I do to your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these things, the works of a prostitute? And you prostituted yourself threefold
source_units.complete_text: What shall I do to your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these things, the works of a prostitute? And you prostituted yourself threefold

source_units.text: among your daughters. You built your brothel at every road head and made your platform in every broad street, and became like a prostitute gathering payments.
source_units.complete_text: among your daughters. You built your brothel at every road head and made your platform in every broad street, and became like a prostitute gathering payments.

source_units.text: The adulterous wife is like you, receiving payments from her husband;
source_units.complete_text: The adulterous wife is like you, receiving payments from her husband;

source_units.text: she kept giving payments to all who prostituted her. You too gave payments to all your lovers and loaded them up to come to you from all around in your prostitution.
source_units.complete_text: she kept giving payments to all who prostituted her. You too gave payments to all your lovers and loaded them up to come to you from all around in your prostitution.

source_units.text: With you it became distorted compared with other women in your prostitution. They have prostituted themselves with you as you paid extra payments, and no payments were given to you; with you things became distorted.
source_units.complete_text: With you it became distorted compared with other women in your prostitution. They have prostituted themselves with you as you paid extra payments, and no payments were given to you; with you things became distorted.

source_units.text: Therefore, prostitute, hear the Lord’s word!
source_units.complete_text: Therefore, prostitute, hear the Lord’s word!

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your copper, your shame will be exposed in your prostitution with your lovers, in all the reflections of your lawlessness, and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your copper, your shame will be exposed in your prostitution with your lovers, in all the reflections of your lawlessness, and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them.

source_units.text: Therefore behold, I am gathering against you all your lovers with whom you mingled, all whom you loved together with all whom you hated. I will gather them against you from all around, reveal your evils to them, and they will see all your shame.
source_units.complete_text: Therefore behold, I am gathering against you all your lovers with whom you mingled, all whom you loved together with all whom you hated. I will gather them against you from all around, reveal your evils to them, and they will see all your shame.

source_units.text: I will exact retribution upon you with the retribution of an adulteress and a woman shedding blood, and place you in blood of wrath and jealousy.
source_units.complete_text: I will exact retribution upon you with the retribution of an adulteress and a woman shedding blood, and place you in blood of wrath and jealousy.

source_units.text: I will hand you into their hands. They will tear down your brothel, pull down your platform, strip your clothing from you, take your vessels of boasting, and leave you naked and exposed.
source_units.complete_text: I will hand you into their hands. They will tear down your brothel, pull down your platform, strip your clothing from you, take your vessels of boasting, and leave you naked and exposed.

source_units.text: They will bring crowds against you, stone you with stones, and slaughter you with their swords.
source_units.complete_text: They will bring crowds against you, stone you with stones, and slaughter you with their swords.

source_units.text: They will burn your houses with fire and exact retributions upon you before many women. I will turn you away from your prostitution, and you certainly will give no more payments.
source_units.complete_text: They will burn your houses with fire and exact retributions upon you before many women. I will turn you away from your prostitution, and you certainly will give no more payments.

source_units.text: I will release My wrath upon you; My jealousy will be removed from you. I will rest and certainly be concerned no longer.
source_units.complete_text: I will release My wrath upon you; My jealousy will be removed from you. I will rest and certainly be concerned no longer.

source_units.text: Because you did not remember the day of your infancy but grieved Me with all these things, behold, I have brought your ways upon your head, says the Lord. Thus you committed impiety in addition to all your lawlessness.
source_units.complete_text: Because you did not remember the day of your infancy but grieved Me with all these things, behold, I have brought your ways upon your head, says the Lord. Thus you committed impiety in addition to all your lawlessness.

source_units.text: These are all the things they said against you in a proverb, saying, ‘As the mother, so the daughter.’
source_units.complete_text: These are all the things they said against you in a proverb, saying, ‘As the mother, so the daughter.’

source_units.text: You are the daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and the sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
source_units.complete_text: You are the daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and the sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

source_units.text: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, dwelling at your left; your sister younger than you, dwelling at your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
source_units.complete_text: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, dwelling at your left; your sister younger than you, dwelling at your right, is Sodom and her daughters.

source_units.text: Not even so did you walk in their ways or act according to their lawlessness. Before long, you surpass them in all your ways.
source_units.complete_text: Not even so did you walk in their ways or act according to their lawlessness. Before long, you surpass them in all your ways.

source_units.text: As I live, says the Lord, your sister Sodom, she and her daughters, certainly did not do as you and your daughters have done.
source_units.complete_text: As I live, says the Lord, your sister Sodom, she and her daughters, certainly did not do as you and your daughters have done.

source_units.text: Yet this was the lawlessness of your sister Sodom: arrogance. In fullness of bread and abundance of wine she and her daughters lived luxuriously. This belonged to her and her daughters, but they did not support the hand of the poor and needy.
source_units.complete_text: Yet this was the lawlessness of your sister Sodom: arrogance. In fullness of bread and abundance of wine she and her daughters lived luxuriously. This belonged to her and her daughters, but they did not support the hand of the poor and needy.

source_units.text: They boasted greatly and committed acts of lawlessness before Me, and I removed them as I saw.
source_units.complete_text: They boasted greatly and committed acts of lawlessness before Me, and I removed them as I saw.

source_units.text: Samaria did not sin half your sins. You multiplied your lawlessness beyond theirs and justified your sisters by all the lawlessness you committed.
source_units.complete_text: Samaria did not sin half your sins. You multiplied your lawlessness beyond theirs and justified your sisters by all the lawlessness you committed.

source_units.text: You too, receive your torment, in which you corrupted your sisters by your sins, in which you acted more lawlessly than they and justified them above yourself. You too, be ashamed and take your dishonor, in that you justified your sisters.
source_units.complete_text: You too, receive your torment, in which you corrupted your sisters by your sins, in which you acted more lawlessly than they and justified them above yourself. You too, be ashamed and take your dishonor, in that you justified your sisters.

source_units.text: I will reverse their reversals—the reversal of Sodom and her daughters; I will reverse the reversal of Samaria and her daughters; and I will reverse your reversal among them,
source_units.complete_text: I will reverse their reversals—the reversal of Sodom and her daughters; I will reverse the reversal of Samaria and her daughters; and I will reverse your reversal among them,

source_units.text: so that you may receive your torment and be dishonored for all you did in provoking Me.
source_units.complete_text: so that you may receive your torment and be dishonored for all you did in provoking Me.

source_units.text: Your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning; Samaria and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning; and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from the beginning.
source_units.complete_text: Your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning; Samaria and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning; and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from the beginning.

source_units.text: And if your sister Sodom was not a report in your mouth in the days of your arrogance,
source_units.complete_text: And if your sister Sodom was not a report in your mouth in the days of your arrogance,

source_units.text: before your evils were revealed—as now you are a reproach of Syria’s daughters and all around her, daughters of foreigners who surround you all around?
source_units.complete_text: before your evils were revealed—as now you are a reproach of Syria’s daughters and all around her, daughters of foreigners who surround you all around?

source_units.text: Your impieties and your lawlessness—you have borne them, says the Lord.
source_units.complete_text: Your impieties and your lawlessness—you have borne them, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: I will deal with you as you have done, as you dishonored these things by transgressing My covenant.
source_units.complete_text: Thus says the Lord: I will deal with you as you have done, as you dishonored these things by transgressing My covenant.

source_units.text: I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your infancy and raise up for you an eternal covenant.
source_units.complete_text: I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your infancy and raise up for you an eternal covenant.

source_units.text: You will remember your way and be dishonored when you take up your sisters, those older than you together with those younger than you. I will give them to you for building up, and not from your covenant.
source_units.complete_text: You will remember your way and be dishonored when you take up your sisters, those older than you together with those younger than you. I will give them to you for building up, and not from your covenant.

source_units.text: I Myself will raise up My covenant with you, and you will recognize that I am the Lord,
source_units.complete_text: I Myself will raise up My covenant with you, and you will recognize that I am the Lord,

source_units.text: so that you may remember and be ashamed, and no longer have occasion to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I am propitious to you concerning all that you have done, says the Lord.’”
source_units.complete_text: so that you may remember and be ashamed, and no longer have occasion to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I am propitious to you concerning all that you have done, says the Lord.’”
